thread:
anya (pm): Quick sync from today's Helios Payments call — they want Private deployment + KMS + 99.9% SLA by May 15. Sharing notes & ask for scope decisions.
maria (acct-exec): They did verbally commit to May 15. SOW signed subject to feasibility. We'll need a firm deliverable list.
raj (eng-lead): May 15 feels tight. We need infra (1) bare metal pool, (2) KMS integration, (3) audit logging + retention. Engineering ETA ~6 weeks after infra ready.
sam (infra): Infra can provision dedicated pool in 2 weeks if we get headcount approved and specs. Need NIC configs and storage size. Who owns security review?
anya (pm): Security review -> noah (sre) + Eng Security. We need FedRAMP-ish checklist? Helios is EU+US; they require audit logs + SOC2 controls.
noah (sre): Ack. I'll start a security intake. Estimate 10 business days for initial review, longer for KMS HSM integration (vendor work).
raj (eng-lead): Proposal: split into milestones: M1 (Private + basic routing + pinning), M2 (KMS + HSM), M3 (SLA & audits). Can we ship M1 by May 15 and negotiate SLA later?
maria (acct-exec): Helios is firm on SLA timeframe. They can accept a phased SLA: 99.5% initial with ramp to 99.9% in 90 days. Will that work?
sam (infra): That ramp sounds doable if we lock autoscale & fallback policies. Need canary and multi-region failover plan.
anya (pm): Acceptance criteria draft (short):
- Private control plane reachable from Helios VPC
- Model pinning & versioning working
- Audit logs stored 1y
- End-to-end smoke tests passing in acct env
- Documented rollback/rollback window

raj (eng-lead): Need a test plan. I'll add jobs:
```
- smoke: generate->chat->validate schema
- perf: 95th latency < 300ms for baseline traffic
- regression: prompt set 50 queries
```
maria (acct-exec): @anya pls capture for SOW. I can push for the phased SLA if we get M1 + perf numbers by May 8.
anya (pm): I updated Helios timeline: aiming for M1 by May 15 (soft), M2 by July 1. If infra lags, fallback propose May 31. Keeping them notified.
noah (sre): Security intake started: ticket S-4821. I'll attach KMS vendor questionnaire. @raj expect some API changes for key rotation hooks.
raj (eng-lead): Noted. I'll allocate one engineer for KMS adapter (2 wks) and one for audit pipeline (1 wk). Still need infra dates.
sam (infra): I'll confirm infra provisioning slots by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/provisioner -> started (job id 9832). ETA 36h.
maria (acct-exec): Thanks team. I'll update customer with the phased SLA + May 15 M1 target and confirm acceptance criteria.
anya (pm): :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a short doc and SOW changes. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall.
